name: ew-manim-draw
description: Bilingual AI-assisted deterministic animated flowchart planning and Manim project generation. Video rendering requires a configured runtime.

interface.longDescription: Turn process descriptions into validated flow structures and Manim-ready animation plans. Render MP4 only when an authorized Manim runtime is available. 將流程描述轉換為可驗證的流程結構及 Manim 動畫規劃；僅在已連接且經授權的 Manim 執行環境中輸出 MP4。
defaultPrompt: Animate my workflow / 將我的工作流程製作成動畫。
Visualize a system architecture / 製作系統架構動畫。
Review and improve this animation plan / 檢查並優化動畫規劃。
